parts.text: I want help finding out which of my drones could get to where a job starts. A company may run a few hundred drones of several models from different manufacturers that differ in how much they can carry, how far they can fly on a full battery, which sensors they carry, and which charging connector they use. Drones fly along corridors between named sites, and sites have only so many places where drones can take off and land at the same time.
